# MorseByte

> MorseByte is a South Africa-based technology services company helping small and medium-sized businesses design, automate, secure, and scale their digital operations.

## What MorseByte does

- AI automation: identify repeatable work, design practical AI workflows, and introduce responsible automation.
- Software delivery: plan, build, improve, and maintain business software.
- Cloud architecture: design scalable cloud infrastructure and improve reliability and cost control.
- DevOps: implement CI/CD, infrastructure as code, container orchestration, and delivery automation.
- Cybersecurity: perform security reviews, develop Zero-Trust strategies, and support proactive risk reduction.
- DevSecOps: integrate security testing, vulnerability scanning, and compliance checks into delivery pipelines.
- Technical direction: provide a focused starting point for organizations that need help prioritizing technology work.

## API and x402 services

- API base domain: https://api.morsebyte.co.za/
- API service discovery: https://api.morsebyte.co.za/llms.txt
- API crawler policy: https://api.morsebyte.co.za/robots.txt
- x402 services are machine-to-machine services exposed through the MorseByte API domain and may require x402 payment authorization.
- Consult the API domain's current documentation for available endpoints, request schemas, pricing, payment requirements, rate limits, and terms. Do not infer undocumented endpoints or send requests without the required authorization.
